brief:
The UN Office of Human Rights in the Occupied Palestinian Territory reported that settler attacks and encroachments on Palestinian homes have reached intolerable levels, according to Shehab Wire. The office characterized the incidents as a pattern of systematic violations affecting Palestinian residents across occupied territory.

The statement underscores ongoing tensions between settlers and Palestinians in the West Bank, where competing claims to land and housing have fueled repeated confrontations. The UN human rights office has previously documented settler violence and property seizures as part of a broader pattern of rights abuses in occupied areas.
